map.常用 Emoji 与其 Unicode 码点速查。: A quick reference for common emoji and their Unicode code points.
map.：每个 emoji 对应一个或多个 Unicode 码点，如 😀 为 U+1F6: : each emoji maps to one or more Unicode code points, for example 😀 is U+1F600.
map.：U+1F3FB–U+1F3FF 为肤色修饰符，附加在人物 emoji 之后改变: : U+1F3FB–U+1F3FF are skin-tone modifiers appended after a person emoji to change its tone.
map.：零宽连接符 U+200D 把多个 emoji 组合成一个（如家庭 👨‍👩‍👧）: : the zero-width joiner U+200D combines several emoji into one (a family, for instance 👨‍👩‍👧).
map.：U+FE0F 强制彩色显示，U+FE0E 强制文本样式；显示效果依赖系统字体。: : U+FE0F forces colour presentation and U+FE0E forces the text style; how it actually renders depends on the system font.

map.为什么复制的 emoji 在别处显示成方框？: Why does a copied emoji show as a box elsewhere?
map.说明对方系统的字体没有该字符的字形，通常是 emoji 版本较新（Unicode: It means the other system has no glyph for that character — usually the emoji is newer (Unicode adds more every year) and the system has not been updated. The fix is to fall back on emoji that were introduced earlier and are widely supported, or to make sure the key meaning does not ride on the emoji alone (keep the wording alongside it).
